# Introduction

This document gives more details of the changes from the original Rocker. 

See the action `repo_update.yml` for an explicit listing of what is copied and maybe gets modified. If any of the original files get changed in the original rocker-version2 repo, then you can use these details here to see if you may need to manually implement changes on the edited versions.   

Apart from github action files, we keep a copy of the original in the same folder as the revised one, using "-master" or "_edit" to indicate. For actions files, this would still run the originals, which we don't want, hence we use a separate folder to keep the originals (`.github/workflow_orignals`), and then copy across back into (`.github/workflow`)

The table gives some comments on why the edits had to happen. 



```{r listing, echo=FALSE}
df <- read.delim("build/reports/edits.tsv")
df 
```

# Comparison

We show the detailed line by line comparison below

```{r comparison, results='asis', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(diffobj)


cat("```diff\n")

df|> 
  filter(original!="" & edited!="") |> 
  select(-comments) |> 
    pmap(\(original, edited){
      system2("git", 
              args = c("diff", "--no-index", original, edited), 
              stdout = TRUE, 
              stderr = TRUE
      )}
    ) |> 
  unlist() |> 
  cat(sep="\n")

    # diffobj::diffFile(original, edited, format="raw",
    #                                         # style = list(html.output = "diff.w.style"), 
    #                                          mode="unified",
    #                                          tar.banner=original,
    #                                          cur.banner=edited
    #                                          ) |> 
    #   as.character() |> 
    #   strsplit("\n") |> 
    #   gsub("&nbsp;", " ", x=_) |>    # Convert HTML spaces back to regular spaces
    #   gsub("&lt;", "<",x=_) |>      # Convert HTML less-than back to <
    #   gsub("&gt;", ">", x=_)   |>   # Convert HTML greater-than back to >
    #   gsub("&amp;", "&", x=_)  |> 
    #   unlist()
    # }) |> unlist() |> cat( sep = "\n")
 cat("\n```")
```
